caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a robed figure standing on a rectangular pedestal. The statue is positioned between two vertical red columns and in front of a semi-circular arch decorated with a blue and red pattern. Behind the statue's head is a circular design with multiple segments in shades of red and orange, resembling a halo or sunburst. The figure is dressed in a long, flowing, blue-gray and brown robe with a broad collar and has short, dark hair. The figure's arms are extended outward and slightly bent at the elbows, with the left hand raised higher than the right. The entire scene is depicted on a plain, light background, with subtle shading to indicate form and depth. The artist's signature, "Juanita Donahoo," is visible in small red letters at the lower right.
title: Statue of Santo (probably St. Dominic)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
